payload.purpose_tldr: Strict boundary: forbidden legacy key at envelope level.
payload.purpose_context: Full strict-profile envelope (all 14 keys) plus the forbidden legacy key mission_key at the top level. validate_event accepts this envelope since 8.0.0 (the Event model ignores unknown keys); the strict profile must still fail closed.

notes: A top-level forbidden key is by definition outside STRICT_ENVELOPE_KEYS, so validate_strict_envelope deterministically reports ENVELOPE_SHAPE_INVALID (extra key) alongside FORBIDDEN_KEY.
